incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert (HIGH) — proxy service error rate spike: 5xxs up 12x in last 3m. Affected route: /v1/generate. Immediate on-call: @Sam_Patel.
Sam Patel: I’m on it. Observed 502/504s from proxy; rolling 5xx rate. Customer impact: some requests timing out/partial failures.
Lina Gomez: Noted. Any correlation IDs in traces?
Sam Patel: pulling traces now. sample corr ids: Z7x9k-3f2, Yt4b1-9aa.
Ben O'Connor: Checking ingress logs — I'm seeing a lot of upstream connection resets to runtime pool and a surge in retries. Logs look like retry amplification.
Sam Patel: grabbing runtime logs, will attach snippets.
Sam Patel: ```
2024-06-05T15:12:21Z proxy-1 request_id=Z7x9k-3f2 backend=runtime-3 status=504 backend_err="timeout after 10s" retries=3
2024-06-05T15:12:22Z proxy-1 request_id=Yt4b1-9aa backend=runtime-2 status=502 backend_err="connect reset" retries=2
```
Lina Gomez: thanks. Looks like proxy is retrying fast which is increasing load on small runtime pool. Are deployment rollouts happening?
deploy-bot: Deploy started by @ci:deploy pipeline to runtime-service at 2024-06-05T15:08:00Z — rollout in progress to 3/5 pods.
Ben O'Connor: that matches. Partial rollout reduced available capacity and some pods are in crashloop -> latency spikes -> proxy retries -> cascading 5xx.
Priya Singh: Estimating customer impact: about 8% of requests got 5xx in the last 10m; top affected customers are interactive-chat workloads with long seq lengths.
Sam Patel: mitigation step 1: pause rollout and scale up runtime pool by +3 replicas. Executing now: `kubectl scale deployment runtime-service --replicas=8 -n prod`.
Ben O'Connor: acknowledging. Also lowering proxy retry attempts to 0 for the route to avoid amplification: changing policy in config map and reloading.
Lina Gomez: where are logs for the initial failures — are KV cache miss ratios high?
Sam Patel: KV cache miss rate jumped 30% for the long-tail prompts during the rollout — new pods had cold caches causing longer backend times.
Sam Patel: ```
kubectl logs runtime-2 -n prod | grep "correlation" | tail -n 30
2024-06-05T15:11:58Z correlation=Yt4b1-9aa seq_len=2048 cache_hit=false latency_ms=10320
```
Priya Singh: Customer impact note: support ticket #5421 from ACME mentions degraded responses between 15:10-15:20 UTC.
Sam Patel: mitigation update: pods scaled to 8, proxy retries set to 0 for /v1/generate, and rollout paused. Observed 5xx rate falling.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Auto-check: 5xx rate decreased to baseline in 4m after mitigations. Continuing monitoring for 15m.
Ben O'Connor: hypothesis list: 1) rollout reduced pool -> cold cache -> backend latency -> proxy retries amplify -> 5xx cascade. 2) retry backoff misconfiguration on proxy (no jitter/fast retry). 3) older pods behind new LB weights causing uneven traffic.
Lina Gomez: Agree with hypothesis 1 + 2. We should add a guard to pause rollouts when backend latency > X. Also add warmup step for KV cache priming.
Sam Patel: Actions captured: - Incident mitigation: scaled runtime +3, paused rollout, reduced retries. - Short term: add rollout guard/traffic draining and cache warmup job. - Long term: implement per-route retry budget and backoff with jitter.
Priya Singh: I’ll update customer communications and add ACME ticket link to the timeline.
Ben O'Connor: logs for post-mitigation window show success; attaching snippet: ```
2024-06-05T15:18:40Z proxy-1 request_id=Z7x9k-3f2 backend=runtime-5 status=200 latency_ms=220
```
Sam Patel: Next steps for RCA doc: collect full KV cache metrics, rollout timing, LB weights, pod restart reasons. I’ll start a timeline draft.
Lina Gomez: assigning owners: Sam -> timeline + logs bundle, Ben -> retry config review + patch, Priya -> customer comms + impact calc, Me (Lina) -> rollout guard spec.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook note saved to /runbooks/incidents/proxy-throttle-1717301234 — include timeline and logs.
Sam Patel: quick question — should we revert to previous traffic weight by shifting 100% to healthy pods? We paused rollout but LB still directs some to new pods.
Ben O'Connor: I recommend draining new pods (scale down annotated) to avoid cold-cache pressure, then resume gradual rollout with warmup.
Sam Patel: doing drain step: `kubectl cordon runtime-7 && kubectl scale deployment runtime-service --replicas=6 -n prod`
Priya Singh: I'll post customer update in #support and link timeline.
Lina Gomez: thanks everyone. Keeping this thread as the incident timeline — please paste any extra logs or traces here.
Sam Patel: closing live mitigation — handoff to RCA phase. Will update this thread with final RCA and postmortem within 48h. :thumbsup:
